criteria.text: Zero {PRINCIPAL.NAME} placeholders remain in agents/*.md files
criteria.description: All 16 occurrences of {PRINCIPAL.NAME} in 13 agent files replaced with "Ivan". Verify: Grep for {PRINCIPAL.NAME} in agents/ returns 0 matches.

criteria.text: All "Ivan" replacements are contextually correct and natural
criteria.description: Each replacement reads naturally in context — no broken grammar, no awkward phrasing. Verify: Read each replaced line, confirm it makes sense.

criteria.text: Each Context.md has corresponding agents/*.md file verified
criteria.description: 10 Context.md files audited. Each has matching agent file. Any orphaned Context.md without agent identified. Verify: List Context.md, cross-check with agents/.

criteria.text: Context.md content is relevant and not stale data
criteria.description: Each Context.md reviewed for: (1) relevance to agent's role, (2) no outdated info, (3) loaded by agent startup instruction. Verify: Read representative Context.md files.

criteria.text: Intern and Pentester agents reference Context.md in startup
criteria.description: Intern.md and Pentester.md are the only agents without Context.md load instructions. Determine if they need one or if it's intentional. Verify: Read both files, check startup sections.

criteria.text: No other unresolved placeholders exist in agent files
criteria.description: Beyond {PRINCIPAL.NAME}, check for other placeholder patterns like {DAIDENTITY.*}, {SETTING.*}, etc. Verify: Grep for curly-brace patterns in agents/.
Line 196 has hardcoded {PRINCIPAL.NAME} as fallback default. Replace with "Ivan". Verify: Grep ComposeAgent.ts for PRINCIPAL returns 0.

criteria.text: ComposeAgent generated agents say Ivan not "the principal"
criteria.description: Line 681 buildSavedAgentBody outputs "the principal needs to hear you speak" — should be "Ivan needs to hear you speak" for consistency with built-in agents. Verify: Grep for "the principal" in ComposeAgent.ts returns 0.

criteria.text: ComposeAgent generated voice messages are in Russian
criteria.description: Lines 657-658 have English startup message "loading and ready to work". Should be Russian like built-in agents. Verify: Read generated curl commands, all Russian.

criteria.text: Research agent API status documented as known limitation
criteria.description: All 5 researcher agents describe using external APIs (Perplexity, Grok, Gemini, Codex) but no MCP servers or env vars configured. All actually use Claude WebSearch. Document as finding. Verify: findings documented.

criteria.text: custom-agents/ directory status explained — empty by design
criteria.description: Directory exists, empty until ComposeAgent --save creates agents. ComposeAgent.ts is fully functional at skills/Agents/Tools/. Not a bug. Verify: ComposeAgent.ts existence confirmed.

criteria.text: Single voice ID status documented as design decision
criteria.description: All 13 agents use pNInz6obpgDQGcFmaJgB. Different voice settings (stability, speed, style) exist per agent. For different voices, ElevenLabs voices needed. Document as future enhancement. Verify: documented.

antiCriteria.text: No agent files broken or corrupted by edits

antiCriteria.text: No Context.md files deleted without explicit approval

antiCriteria.text: No functional agent behavior changed by edits
